What happens when the limited-time offer ends?
Free accounts go back to 20 dynamic codes, and Pro accounts stay unlimited. Nothing happens to codes you already created — they keep working.
If I cancel Pro, do my codes stop working?
No. Your codes keep working after a subscription ends. You just return to the free limit for creating new dynamic codes.
How do refunds work?
If this is your first subscription, you can ask for a full refund within 7 days of your first payment — write to hello@freeqrly.com. The full billing terms are in the Terms of Service.
